# Everything about the perk loadouts

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_35_nukaknights-post-loadouts.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

From our PTS thread here in the Nuka Knights group you already know many details of the upcoming changes in Patch 26 on April 27th, 2021.

Here I'll explain how the long-awaited perk loadouts work.

- 
 **2 loadouts** are initially available to you, up to 11 more can be purchased in the Atom Shop for Atoms
- 
 **SPECIAL points can be distributed freely**, leveling up is no longer required for the distribution of points
- 
 The loadouts can be named **anything**
- 
 **Legendary SPECIALS** are seamlessly added to the SPECIAL points
- 
 The loadouts can be changed **at any time with one click** on a punch card machine
- 
 **Perk cards** that you change (even without a punch card machine) are **saved in the active perk loadout**

## WHERE CAN YOU FIND THE PUNCH CARD MACHINES?

You can set up the punch card machines in your **CAMP**. Furthermore, there is such a machine at **every train station**.

You can also use the punch card machines and the stash boxes in other **CAMPs**.

You can only change the active loadout using the punch card machines.

## CREATE AND CHANGE LOADOUTS

At the beginning you have a loadout, your current build. You can rename this first if you want.

When you create a 2nd build, the first thing you do is choose your SPECIAL points. Legendary SPECIALS are taken into account. This means that if you have equipped legendary strength +5, you will receive your legendary SPECIAL points in addition to the SPECIAL points when the cards are distributed, as before.

Once you have distributed the points, you can now distribute your available perk cards among the points, just like you currently do.

You can now move your SPECIAL points as you wish at any time using a punch card machine.

If you change perk cards in your PipBoy, this setup will be saved in your active loadout from the punch card machine. The loadouts are not standard loadouts that you can restore, but change with every map change. It's best to set your cards back to standard before changing the loadouts.

The legendary perks remain the same for every loadout selected.

## CONCLUSION

This means that the loadouts are a good thing, and it is now much easier to change the SPECIAL points.

For example, I use different legendary perks on my melee character than on my Pistolero and Heavy Gunner. A single character cannot be completely reskilled as desired, as it is no longer just the cards that are important, but also the legendary perks.

The loadouts now open up new possibilities for us and perhaps there will be interesting expansions in the future.

It would perhaps be desirable to have a punch card machine in the survival tent in the future, so that it would be even easier to change.
